Kit summary

Spell BreakingBasic
Deals 2 stages of Direct DMG and [Bleed] DMG by 120% of ATK each to a single enemy, with a 50% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Bleed] for 2 turns.
Essence ReaperActiveExclusive Lv.1
Deals 400% ATK [Bleed] DMG to a single enemy, with a 70% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Bleed] for 2 turns. Afterward, gains [Extraction] based on the layers of [Bleed] owned by the target. Each layer of [Extraction] increases self Mastery by 5% permanently, up to 20 layers.
Execution Blades Lv.1When Essence Reaper deals DMG, inflicts 3 layers of [Bleed] instead, refreshes the duration of all layers of [Bleed] owned by the target, and doubles Mastery granted by each layer of [Extraction]. At the first 2 turns of Vassili each wave, grants [Cruor] (Immune to [Bleed] DMG) on all allies.
Execution RewardsPassiveExclusive Lv.2
Vassili is immune to Turn Meter Reduction effect. When he inflicts [Bleed] on enemies with 10 layers of [Bleed] or above, for each layer of [Bleed] successfully inflicted, additionally deals 180% ATK [Bleed] DMG, and this DMG has a 50% fixed chance to be increased to 1.5x of the original.
Execution Blades Lv.2The extra [Bleed] DMG dealt by Execution Rewards is guaranteed to be increased to 1.5x of the original and has an extra 30% fixed chance to be tripled. Vassili can increase up to 100% Effect Hit for self based on 50% of self initial Mastery. When a Vassili's turn starts, he gains [Stealth] for 1 turn.
Insane CleaveActiveExclusive Lv.3
Deals 7 stages of 90% ATK [Bleed] DMG each to a single enemy, with a 70% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Bleed] for 2 turns. Meanwhile, steals 100% of DMG AMP from the target for 1 turn.
Execution Blades Lv.3Grants [Resolute II] on all allies for 2 turns before Insane Cleave deals DMG. Afterward, each stage of DMG additionally deals [Bleed] DMG by 50% of ATK. When the target owns 4/8 or more layers of [Bleed], increases the extra [Bleed] DMG dealt by each stage of this effect to 80%/120% of ATK. DMG dealt by Insane Cleave ignores [Immortal], [DMG RES], and [Shield]; up to 6 layers of [Bleed] can be triggered additionally after dealing DMG.
